characters.description: Haven’s owner, a D-grade hunter and accomplished alchemist preparing for the Treasure Hunt. At Miranda’s request, he makes his strength unmistakable to the independent fighters gathered in his city.
characters.name: Jake Thayne

characters.description: Jake's powerful hawk companion, treated as family and already capable of operating on her own. She accompanies him before the Treasure Hunt and helps establish that Haven is far better defended than its visitors first assume.
characters.name: Sylphie

characters.description: Haven's organizer and a user of green magic. She assembles the city's prospective Treasure Hunt entrants, manages their preparations, and asks Jake to demonstrate the power protecting Haven before visitors mistake restraint for weakness.
characters.name: Miranda

characters.description: A secluded Haven craftsman who is initially the highest-level person visible among the city's assembled entrants. His reputation rests more on making things than on public displays of combat power, leaving many visitors unsure what he can do.
characters.name: Arnold

characters.description: Jake’s primordial patron, also known as the Malefic Viper. Their divine connection is an established part of Jake’s path before the Treasure Hunt.
characters.name: Villy

characters.description: A Haven space mage and teleportation researcher known before the Treasure Hunt begins. His work gives the city expertise in spatial travel and magical transport, making him an important part of its developing infrastructure.
characters.name: Neil

characters.description: Jake's brother and a leader of the Court of Shadows. While his organization prepares its Treasure Hunt force, Caleb trains alone in a chamber designed to impose extreme pressure, leaving the immediate entry arrangements to others.
characters.name: Caleb

characters.description: The Holy Church's Augur, responsible for organizing its Treasure Hunt groups and guiding their search. He assigns himself to a treasure-seeking party with Bertram while directing the wider Church effort.
characters.name: Jacob

characters.description: Jacob's guardian and a Holy Church fighter. He joins the Augur's treasure-seeking group as the Church divides its entrants into smaller teams, providing direct combat support while Jacob guides the wider search.
characters.name: Bertram

characters.description: A curse-focused Risen combatant who plans to enter the Treasure Hunt with Lyra. He belongs to the large Risen force under Priscilla’s political leadership.
characters.name: Casper

characters.description: Casper's Risen co-operator and intended Treasure Hunt partner. She enters with him as part of the organized force led by Priscilla, giving Casper a trusted partner within the faction's much larger expedition.
characters.name: Lyra

characters.description: The political leader of the large Risen contingent entering the Treasure Hunt. Casper and Lyra are among the roughly one thousand entrants assembled under her direction, making the Risen one of the event's largest organized forces.
characters.name: Priscilla

characters.description: The Noboru Clan patriarch and an elite swordsman who expects to confront Jake during the Treasure Hunt. His personal strength makes him one of the event's most dangerous known entrants.
characters.name: Sword Saint

characters.description: An independent merchant who offers to travel with Miranda after entering the mist-covered realm. When she declines, he proceeds with his remaining follower.
characters.name: Sultan

characters.description: A formidable Valhal fighter who encounters Sylphie while hunting vampiric creatures in a bunker. Despite an awkward first approach and no shared language, she chooses to cooperate with the hawk against the surrounding enemies.
characters.name: Carmen

characters.description: The Noboru Clan patriarch's great-granddaughter, combining sword training with alchemy and advanced magical theory. After hearing that Jake killed a Count of Blood, she joins him at a cursed puzzle and identifies a flaw in his model.
characters.name: Reika

characters.description: An unidentified fighter able to heal so rapidly that he outlasts a Viscount. Feeding on him poisons the vampire, and after winning he searches for a more dangerous foe.
characters.name: Regenerating Fighter

characters.description: Caleb identifies Aaron as a dangerous opponent after hearing that he lived through a clash with an uncontrolled Count.
characters.name: Aaron

characters.description: An archer serving in Bertram's coordinated Holy Church party. She supports the group's Count hunt alongside its healer, light mage, and swordsman, contributing ranged attacks to a tightly organized team.
characters.name: Maria

characters.description: The title used for Carmen by Valhal fighters when reinforcements arrive to support her group. She is already established as a powerful close-range combatant and Sylphie's current hunting partner, and the arriving party clearly recognizes her standing.
characters.name: Rune Maiden

characters.description: A leader of the Valhal party arriving to support Carmen, Miranda, and Sylphie. He addresses Carmen as the Rune Maiden when the reinforcements join her group.
characters.name: Sven

characters.description: Sultan's contracted pathfinder. Her ability to mark targets and perceive through them helps him locate a defended vault in the expanded Treasure Hunt territory, supplying the guidance needed for his armed ship to approach its objective.
characters.name: Summer

characters.description: An elemental mage trapped with Jake and several others by a vast cube puzzle. He specializes in construction, reinforcement, material alteration, and elemental magic circles, making him one of the group's principal solvers.
characters.name: Elemental Mage

characters.description: An assassin from the Court of Shadows trapped with Jake's group by the cube puzzle. Knowledge of gunsmithing, enchantment, and runes makes this fighter one of the principal contributors to solving it.
characters.name: Court of Shadows Assassin

characters.description: A swordsmith and close-range fighter trapped with Jake's group by the cube puzzle. She provides limited help with the puzzle while the group works to escape the hidden space.
characters.name: Swordsmith Rogue

characters.description: An earth mage trapped with Jake's group by the cube puzzle. He takes part in the group's effort to complete the puzzle and leave the hidden space.
characters.name: Earth Mage

characters.description: A level-130 healer and pioneering city lord who commands the independent force surrounding Jake's cube-vault group. He leads the organized effort to drive Jake out of the Treasure Hunt.
characters.name: Independent City Lord

characters.description: The elemental mage from the cube puzzle group. He receives the Staff of Elemental Confluence when the rewards are divided, then continues exploring with Felicia after expressing interest in visiting Haven.
characters.name: Roman

characters.description: The swordsmith rogue who helped Jake's group survive the cube vault and the ambush that followed. Primarily a melee fighter, she receives a protective spatial ring when the group divides its rewards, then chooses to continue exploring with Roman.
characters.name: Felicia

characters.description: Yalsten's awakened vampire ruler, initially degraded by the realm's curse. He rises amid hundreds of cursed soldiers and five royal guards as the world begins collapsing, becoming the final quest's central enemy.
characters.name: Cursed Monarch

characters.description: The restored form of Yalsten's cursed ruler after he invokes Sanguine's blood legacy. Freed from the realm's curse and accompanied by blood elementals made from the fallen, he becomes an even greater threat to the exhausted coalition.
characters.name: Monarch of Blood

characters.description: The personal name of the Sword Saint, the Noboru Clan patriarch now dueling Jake for Sanguine's blood legacy. He rejected a divine blessing that demanded his clan's submission to the Holy Church and has built his path around swordsmanship and responsibility to his family.
characters.name: Miyamoto

characters.description: An unresponsive unique lifeform residing in Jake's mask after the King of the Forest dies. It may possess the king's memories, but whether it shares the king's identity or intentions remains unknown.
characters.name: Mask Lifeform
